# Imperial Finishing Ltd

> Imperial Finishing Ltd is a custom finishing carpentry company in Calgary, Alberta, that also works in Lake Country, British Columbia. It is owned and run by Mike Robertson, a journeyman finishing carpenter. Established 2003.

## Quick facts
- Business: Imperial Finishing Ltd
- Trade: custom finishing carpentry (also called finish carpentry or trim carpentry)
- Owner: Mike Robertson, journeyman finishing carpenter
- Based in: Calgary, Alberta, Canada
- Service area: Calgary and surrounding communities; Lake Country and the Okanagan, BC
- Established: 2003
- Quotes: send the quote form at https://northcreststudio.github.io/imperial-finishing/#quote with photos of the space
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/imperial.finishing.ltd/

## Services
- [Kitchen cabinet installation](https://northcreststudio.github.io/imperial-finishing/#services): cabinets set level and square, fitted tight to walls and ceilings.
- [Trim and baseboards](https://northcreststudio.github.io/imperial-finishing/#services): baseboards, casing and crown moulding with tight mitres and clean inside corners.
- [Interior doors and hardware](https://northcreststudio.github.io/imperial-finishing/#services): doors hung with even reveals, casing, closet doors and hardware.
- [Built-ins and millwork](https://northcreststudio.github.io/imperial-finishing/#services): shelving, benches, mudroom lockers, entertainment walls and pantry storage.
- [Stairs and railings](https://northcreststudio.github.io/imperial-finishing/#services): treads, risers, skirt boards, newel posts and railings.
- [Wainscoting and feature walls](https://northcreststudio.github.io/imperial-finishing/#services): wainscoting, board and batten, and panel moulding.

## Questions and answers
### What is finishing carpentry?
Finishing carpentry is the last carpentry stage in a home: installing the trim, doors, cabinets, built-ins and stair parts that stay visible after drywall and paint. It is also called finish carpentry or trim carpentry.

### What does Imperial Finishing do?
Imperial Finishing Ltd does custom finishing carpentry: kitchen cabinet installation, baseboards, casing and crown moulding, interior doors and hardware, built-ins, stairs and railings, and wainscoting.

### Where does Imperial Finishing work?
Imperial Finishing works in Calgary, Alberta and surrounding communities, and in Lake Country in British Columbia's Okanagan.

### What affects the cost of finishing carpentry?
The main cost drivers are the amount of trim or number of pieces, the profile and material (paint-grade MDF or stain-grade hardwood), how many corners and cuts there are, and how level and square the walls are. A walkthrough gives you an exact number.

### How long does a finishing carpentry job take?
Baseboards and casing for a typical room often take a day or less. A full kitchen of cabinets usually takes several days. Start dates depend on the current schedule.

### Paint-grade or stain-grade trim: what's the difference?
Paint-grade trim is usually MDF or finger-jointed pine that gets filled, caulked and painted. Stain-grade trim is solid wood such as oak, chosen for its grain, so the joints have to be tight because there is no caulk to hide them.

### What is the difference between finish carpentry and framing?
Framing builds the structure of a house: walls, floors and roof. Finish carpentry comes after drywall and installs the woodwork you see every day, such as trim, doors, cabinets and built-ins.

### Do I need a permit for finishing work?
Trim, doors, cabinets and built-ins generally do not need a building permit on their own. Permits usually come into play when walls, structure, plumbing or electrical change as part of a wider renovation.

### How do I get a quote from Imperial Finishing?
Use the quote form on this page: choose the work you need, add your location, timing and photos of the space, and Mike Robertson will get back to you to set up a walkthrough and a written quote.
